Behavior.description:
A behavior: one `lookup` view, run for a turn with the slots the local
model pulls from it. Only `slots` may be filled (E4B over-fills: a status
or a topic nobody asked for); the view's preset holds the rest.

says.description: What it answers, as the picker reads it.

slots.description: The view's slots the model may fill from the turn.

unless.description:
A case-insensitive regex that rules the behavior out: the turn names
something narrower that another route reads ("claims from the last 2
days", "videos today").

when.description:
A case-insensitive regex the turn must match for the behavior to run:
code decides that it fits, the model only that it is wanted. A pick of
it for a turn that does not match goes to the stored agent. (`learned`
as a bare choice drew 8 turns it did not fit, any "what have we learned
about X"; its `when` is a time window.)

PromptSection.description: One part of a profile's prompt.

generate.description:
`tools`: the catalogue of the profile's available tools, one line each
from the registry's descriptions. Replaces a hand-written list.

requires.description:
Tools the section is about; it is left out unless every one is
available to the profile (its allowlist, intersected with the registry).

when.description:
A regex (case-insensitive): the section is left out of a turn whose
message (an agent run: its task) does not match, so text that serves
one kind of turn is not paid on every other (HARNESS2_PLAN Phase 4).
A render with no turn in hand (a preview) keeps it.

RouteChoice.description: One routing choice that is not an agent.

says.description: What it is for, as the picker reads it.

RoutingSpec.description:
How a front door routes a turn. The choices are the spawnable agents (with
their `specialty`) and then `choices`, in order.

behaviors.description:
Behaviors (GRAPH_CONTEXT_PLAN Phase B): a turn one fits is run by
code, with no agent loop. Offered to the picker as `lookup:<name>`.

choices.description: Choices besides the agents: the front door's own tools and `answer`.

confident.description:
The checker's probability at or above which its pick needs no second
reading (the owner's 85% rule; calibrated on eval/routing_golden.yaml).

rules.description: The rules the picker reads with the choices (the owner's graded ones).

stored.description: The agent that holds what is stored (`knowledge-worker`).

web.description: The agent that searches the web (`researcher`).

web_words.description:
A case-insensitive regex: a turn that matches asks for the web or for
facts that change. A pick of `web` for a turn that does not match goes
to `stored` first (accuracy first: what we have, then the world).

description: Declarative "mini-agent contract" loaded from a YAML file.

data_class.description:
Who may see this profile's turns (`services/routing.rs`): `private`
(the default when absent) keeps them on `no_log` providers; `public`
also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A sub-agent run uses
the stricter of this and its caller's class.

explicit_only.description:
Runnable only when named in a `run_agent` step, never offered to a
model: left out of the `delegate` roster and `run_agent(agent:"auto")`,
and refused by chat `delegate`. For an agent a human must choose to run
(none ships today; a paid model is pinned per step with `run_agent`'s
`model` instead, as `workflows/deep-dive-hard.yaml` does).

fallback_models.description:
Models to step down to, in order, when `model_preference` fails or is
refused — before the global `chat_fallback_ladder`. Catalog names, so a
profile can say "another Gemini first, then Ollama Cloud". Every rung is
still judged by the routing policy and the budget. `/chat` only.

retrieval_exclude.description:
Notes this profile's `search_notes` never returns, applied when it runs
as an agent (`run_agent`/`delegate`). See `RetrievalExclude`.

routing.description:
A front door's router (GRAPH_CONTEXT_PLAN Phase 3): before the turn,
a local model picks where it goes first, and the pick is put in front
of this profile's model. `None` = no router.

sections.description:
Prompt parts after `system_prompt`, each kept only when the tools it
`requires` are available (`services/profiles.rs`).

session_prefixes.description:
Chat sessions whose id starts with one of these run this profile when
the request names none: a workflow that opens a session for replies
(`notify_user` with a session id) owns the replies, however terse.

side_effects.description:
Whether an item assigned to this agent may run on its own
(`read_only`) or must wait for the user's approval (`writes`). Absent,
it is derived from `tools` and fails safe (`items::side_effects`): an
override is a deliberate, reviewable act.

spawnable.description:
Whether this profile may be invoked as a sub-agent by an orchestrator via
`delegate`. Default false — the human entry points (`general`,
`orchestrator`) must never be spawnable, which would let an orchestrator
delegate to itself. See project-docs/SUBAGENT_ORCHESTRATION_PLAN.md §3.1.

specialty.description:
One-line description of what this agent is *for*, injected into the
orchestrator's `delegate` roster so it knows when to pick this worker.
Falls back to `description` when absent.

title: ContextProfile
